The '''Grand Trophy''' was a special trophy won by [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] junk dealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] from a tournament that took place on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. It was lined among the walls of his nest in his [[Wald's Parts|shop]].
